@Gideon, draft from #inc-vtg-hartford (Aug 3, 2026, Vantorre Hartford gate kiosks):

Incident summary (draft)
- First report: 10:42 AM. Gate kiosks offline at the Hartford plant; both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan. Gate check-in was done on paper; scheduling still worked from the dispatch office.
- Kiosk 1 back: 11:03 AM. Guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch saw it.
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM (posted in the incident room at 11:08 AM).
- Open item: status-page access for Mateo's login is still being investigated under INC-4821. Mateo's admin account can open Pemberline Dock and see arrivals.

The times are as posted in the incident room; the channel doesn't state a time zone, so please confirm before it goes to procurement.
